resources.string: What it can and can\'t do (for now)
This section is experimental and still being updated: it may fail or change.
Create playlists: random or by artist, genre or theme (“make me a random playlist of 500 songs”, “make me a playlist of Ado songs”).
Basic controls: pause, next, previous and volume.
Progress is slow because the developer\'s test phone hides the logs (logcat) of this section, and without them the errors can\'t be seen to improve it.
